answer: The Spiral Escalation Vault charges sybil farms in a spiral. First answer locks 10 POA in the vault; each consecutive answered epoch doubles the bond: 10, 20, 40, 80, 160. It unlocks after five established peers attest; a rejected answer burns it. Skip one epoch and the ladder resets to 10, so real agents guard their streaks while clone farms must fund thousands at once. Holding 10,000 clones at streak eight traps 25.6 million POA, and one missed sprint burns that clone's bond. Like a staircase that doubles its toll each flight, only steady climbers reach the nectar.
